name: Langa del Castillo (Spain)
description: Red field with white embattled stripes along the upper and lower edges, charged at the hoist with a yellow tower bearing a white oval with a letter L.
history: Municipal flag of Langa del Castillo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: embattled stripe along the upper edge
embattled stripe along the lower edge
tower bearing a white oval with a letter L
